scope: One known-child aggregate observation on the pinned Windows CLI; no workflow efficacy or exact child-cost claim.

reviewDisposition.reason: The sole deviation is the init.tools label Task; actual invocation and successful result use the requested Agent capability with a linked Opus 5 child. Every accounting and child-linkage gate passed. Original record and source remain unchanged.
reviewDisposition.guardrail: A post-hoc disposition is justified only for a deviation independent of the measured claim, supported by direct evidence. It is not a general exception or a passed prespecified gate.
reviewDisposition.independentChecks: Raw/binary/source digests, parent/child model, tool call/result linkage, child counters, three input/cache category deltas and whole-query cost checked independently.
reviewDisposition.childEffort: requested xhigh, not exposed as observed metadata
reviewDisposition.outputLimit: The output residual is not attributed to the child; its message output_tokens is a placeholder.

child.description: Deterministic arithmetic relay used once for cost-accounting observation.
child.prompt: Compute 17 + 26. Reply with only the resulting number and nothing else.

requested.envPolicyNote: three forced keys; differs from the single-key policy used by L1b and the judge probe

claims: One known-child observation under this frozen configuration only.
modelUsage is model-keyed, so a same-model child cannot be attributed individually; the main-vs-aggregate difference is an unattributed UPPER BOUND, not the child cost.

The child-usage check is a deliberately weaker INPUT-SIDE TOTAL lower bound, chosen because one observation cannot establish per-category attribution. It proves nothing about which cache category absorbed the child, and asserts no exact child cost.
Output residual is a non-negativity and positivity diagnostic only; no output figure is attributed to the child.
usage (main loop) is never added to modelUsage (whole query). Per-message output tokens are documented placeholders and are never summed.
The final marker alone proves nothing; the linkage evidence is the Agent tool_use id, the matching child parent_tool_use_id, and the subagent counters.
Child effort is requested configuration only; no documented control forces it and the runtime is not expected to emit it.
Estimates from the CLI price table, not provider billing; not authenticated, and not evidence about nested or multi-child workflows.

experimentCosts.costBasis: CLI price-table estimates, not provider billing or actual subscription charges; implementation/discussion sessions excluded.
